meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会只读地分析当前 GitHub 仓库里所有打开的 issue 和 PR:每个都单独分析,把结论写成带链接证据的报告,存到 /tmp 下按日期建的文件夹。它只写报告,绝不会评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等触发词时,Claude 就会开始对所在 GitHub 仓库执行只读分析。

say.note: 逐个分析所有打开的 issue 并写报告。

howto.what_en: Read-only triage: analyzes all open issues and PRs (one background task each), writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{timestamp}. Every claim needs a GitHub permalink. Never mutates GitHub — reports only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc. It then starts read-only analysis of the current GitHub repository.

say_en.note: Analyzes all open issues; writes to /tmp date folder.
Reviews each open PR; writes evidence-backed report.
Triages all open issues and PRs read-only.
